teams.product_capability: Learned legal distance metric that optimizes nearest-neighbor retrieval for jurist usefulness, exposed as a selectable map mode alongside the validated center_projected baseline
teams.question: Does a supervised metric learning approach (Mahalanobis/linear metric) trained on Jurivoc descriptors and TF branch/legal_area metadata as weak supervision, fusing the validated center_projected baseline with legal-specific signals (sachverhalt TF-IDF, erwaegungen TF-IDF, norm/article embeddings, citation role weights, cited_decisions_tfidf), produce legally more useful nearest neighbors than the unsupervised center_projected baseline AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf signal?
teams.hypothesis: A metric learned from Jurivoc/TF weak labels will optimally weight complementary legal signals (facts for legal_area coherence, reasoning for citation proximity, norms for doctrinal proximity, citation roles for precedent proximity, cited decisions for citation heritage) and suppress boilerplate, beating both the unsupervised center_projected baseline AND the zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf signal on jurist proxy benchmarks (branch_knn, legal_area_clustering, citation_heritage, tf_metadata_human_indexing) while maintaining zoom_coherence and multilingual_invariance.
teams.why_now: CONCRETE EVIDENCE: (1) Evaluation v3 FREEZES center_projected_64dim as validated baseline: passes BOTH adversarial gates (LangDom=0.766<0.85, JP=0.512>0.5). (2) Core legal-distance v6 achieved METRIC LEARNING BREAKTHROUGH on center_projected space: linear projection JP=0.6847, mahalanobis JP=0.6781 (per frozen harness v3 seed=42), both pass BOTH adversarial gates with 18+ consecutive valid epochs. (3) NEW CRITICAL FINDING: cited_decisions_tfidf (zero-shot citation TF-IDF) achieves jurist preference 0.6922 and language dominance 0.6107 — BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise WITHOUT training. All 6 cited_decisions_tfidf + center_projected hybrids PASS both gates. Best hybrid: cited_decisions_tfidf_hybrid_cp64_0.7 (jurist=0.6614, lang_dom=0.6542). (4) Legal-distance v4 ACCEPTED reveals COMPLEMENTARY signal strengths: section_sachverhalt wins legal_area (NMI 0.4782, purity 0.8571); section_erwaegungen wins citation_proximity (AUC 0.6562); language_debiased_pca2 wins citation_graph (AUC 0.7046) and legal_area (NMI 0.4373). (5) Corpus provides weak supervision: Jurivoc descriptors + TF branch/legal_area metadata on 1000+ decisions. (6) Fractal-map validated (hierarchical Leiden nesting=1.0, purity=0.9571) provides evaluation harness. (7) Statute extractor maps 43 laws; citation graph has 2105 refs. (8) Legal-distance v5 REPRODUCED: scale test confirms generalization, legal embeddings reveal trade-offs, citation roles provide new signal dimension, jurist framework ready. (9) Citation role modeling BLOCKED: 2,988 role annotations exist but BGE/ATF → decision_id resolution pipeline missing.
teams.non_duplication: Core legal-distance lane performs UNSUPERVISED signal ablation (systematic combination/weighting of legal signals against frozen baseline) AND METRIC LEARNING on center_projected space (linear + Mahalanobis projections). This team pursues SUPERVISED METRIC LEARNING on weak labels (Jurivoc/TF metadata) fusing MULTIPLE legal signals including the NEW cited_decisions_tfidf signal — fundamentally different methodology. Core lane asks 'what learned metric on center_projected space optimizes jurist proxies?'; this team asks 'what learned metric optimally fuses center_projected + cited_decisions_tfidf + legal signals for jurist proxy objectives using Jurivoc supervision?'. Independent path: Jurivoc-supervised multi-signal fusion (including citation heritage signal) vs. center_projected-space metric learning. PAUSED because core lane breakthrough + cited_decisions_tfidf achieve primary acceptance criteria; may be rechartered if multi-signal fusion shows additional gains.

teams.acceptance_test: On the frozen 1000-decision evaluation sample: (1) Learned metric achieves >=5% relative improvement over cited_decisions_tfidf baseline (jurist=0.6922) on at least 3 of 4 primary jurist proxies: branch_knn@1, legal_area_clustering purity, citation_heritage AUC, tf_metadata_human_indexing recall@1. (2) No regression on zoom_coherence (improvement_rate >= 0.39, aligned to validated fractal-map baseline 0.3964) or multilingual_invariance (adversarial_language_dominance < 0.85). (3) Boilerplate_resistance_real_corpus PASS (text_emb_correlation <= 0.2). (4) Metric is serializable and loadable in product for map mode switching. (5) Learned metric meets or exceeds cited_decisions_tfidf on adversarial_language_dominance (< 0.6107) and jurist_pairwise_preference (> 0.6922) benchmarks. NOTE: Core lane linear_metric_epoch4 achieves JP=0.6847 (33.7% relative improvement over center_projected 0.5121) with LangDom=0.673, passing both adversarial gates (per frozen harness v3 seed=42). cited_decisions_tfidf achieves JP=0.6922 with LangDom=0.6107. Frontier must beat BOTH new baselines.
teams.stop_promote_rule: PROMOTE to product integration if acceptance_test passes AND metric generalizes to held-out 2024 test slice (temporal_stability mean_knn_score >= 0.75) AND beats BOTH core lane linear_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.6847 per frozen harness) AND cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6922 per frozen harness) on jurist pairwise. PAUSE if no improvement after 3 architecture variants (linear, diagonal, low-rank Mahalanobis) OR if core lane metric learning breakthrough + cited_decisions_tfidf satisfies product capability. TERMINATE if learned metric collapses (collapse_check FAIL) or violates multilingual_invariance (adversarial_language_dominance >= 0.85). SUPERSEDED by charter_version+1 if evidence warrants hypothesis change. CURRENT STATUS: PAUSED - core lane metric learning breakthrough (linear JP=0.6847, mahalanobis JP=0.6781 per frozen harness) AND cited_decisions_tfidf zero-shot breakthrough (JP=0.6922, LangDom=0.6107) jointly achieve primary product capability; frontier recharter only if Jurivoc-supervised multi-signal fusion (including citation heritage) shows credible additional gains beyond ALL current baselines.

teams.product_capability: Cross-lingually aligned legal embeddings that achieve language dominance < 0.6 (beating cited_decisions_tfidf 0.6107) while preserving coarse legal structure, exposed as a 'Cross-Lingual Legal' map mode for multilingual Swiss case law navigation
teams.question: Does fine-tuning multilingual-e5-small on the Swiss Federal Supreme Court corpus (with Jurivoc/TF branch/legal_area weak supervision and/or contrastive legal issue pairs) produce embeddings that achieve adversarial_language_dominance < 0.6 AND jurist_pairwise_preference > 0.5 AND cross_language_retrieval > 0.2, while maintaining zoom_coherence improvement_rate >= 0.39 on the fractal map?
teams.hypothesis: multilingual-e5-small fine-tuned on Swiss legal corpus with (a) Jurivoc/TF branch-legal_area contrastive pairs, (b) section-specific training (sachverhalt/erwaegungen/dispositiv separation), and/or (c) citation-heritage positive pairs will learn cross-lingual legal invariance that generic legal embeddings catastrophically fail at (LangDom ~1.0), because the fine-tuning objective directly optimizes for legal equivalence across languages rather than semantic similarity.
teams.why_now: CONCRETE ACCEPTED EVIDENCE: (1) BOILERPLATE RESISTANCE CORRECTION (REPRODUCED tier): Real test shows 89-93% neighbor preservation when boilerplate removed — boilerplate NOT driving neighbors. v3 'boilerplate_resistance' proxy MISNAMED; measured language dominance (cross-lingual alignment failure). SYSTEMIC CHALLENGE IS CROSS-LINGUAL ALIGNMENT. (2) Legal embeddings CATASTROPHICALLY FAIL: multilingual-e5-small, MiniLM, xlm-roberta all achieve LangDom ~1.0 on frozen harness v3 (seed=42). (3) cited_decisions_tfidf achieves BEST LangDom=0.6107 (zero-shot) but target is <0.6 — gap is small but meaningful. (4) Core legal-distance lane question explicitly identifies this path: 'Test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuning on Swiss legal corpus for multilingual invariance WITH coarse legal structure (GPU required; code ready from v6)'. (5) Cross-lingual alignment is INDEPENDENT PATH from metric learning (operates on center_projected space) and citation signal work — can run in parallel. (6) GPU requirement makes this a natural frontier team (resource-isolated, specialized). (7) Jurist framework ready for human validation of cross-lingual map modes.
teams.non_duplication: Core legal-distance lane does UNSUPERVISED signal ablation + metric learning ON center_projected space. This team does SUPERVISED FINE-TUNING of a multilingual foundation model (multilingual-e5-small) on Swiss legal corpus — fundamentally different representation space (native 384-dim multilingual vs projected 64/128/768-dim). Core lane optimizes metric on existing embeddings; this team learns NEW embeddings with cross-lingual legal invariance baked in. Independent path: foundation model fine-tuning vs. metric learning on fixed embeddings. Legal-distance v5 already tested off-the-shelf legal embeddings (all fail LangDom ~1.0); this team tests if fine-tuning fixes the cross-lingual alignment failure.
